$comment: Classes that appear in official SLDS 1 blueprint markup but have NO rule in the installed CSS (@salesforce-ux/design-system 2.264.3). scripts/verify-slds accepts them ONLY from this list. Blueprint source: salesforce-ux/design-system@main (2.28.1), ui/components/*. Add an entry only when a component copies blueprint markup that contains the class. Never invent classes.

slds-dropdown__list.reason: Structural hook on the menu list; styling comes from .slds-dropdown and .slds-dropdown__item.

slds-is-required.reason: State marker on required checkbox groups; the visible asterisk is .slds-required.

slds-listbox__item.blueprint: Combobox listbox / Dueling picklist (ui/components/combobox/listbox/index.jsx, dueling-picklist/index.jsx: li.slds-listbox__item)
slds-listbox__item.reason: Structural hook on listbox rows; styling comes from .slds-listbox__option.

slds-listbox__option-text.reason: Base element class of the option text; only the _entity modifier has CSS.

slds-listbox__option-meta_entity.reason: Entity modifier of the meta line; styling comes from .slds-listbox__option-meta.

slds-global-actions__help.blueprint: Global Header — global actions (ui/components/global-header/global-actions/index.jsx: Help button)
slds-global-actions__help.reason: Identifies the Help & Training action button; no CSS rule in 2.264.3.

slds-global-actions__setup.blueprint: Global Header — global actions (ui/components/global-header/global-actions/index.jsx: Setup button)
slds-global-actions__setup.reason: Identifies the Setup action button; no CSS rule in 2.264.3.

slds-page-header_record-home.blueprint: Page Headers — record home (ui/components/page-headers/index.jsx: PageHeader isRecordHome)
slds-page-header_record-home.reason: Variant marker on the record-home header; no CSS rule in 2.264.3.

slds-page-header_related-list.blueprint: Page Headers — related list (ui/components/page-headers/index.jsx: PageHeader isRelatedList)
slds-page-header_related-list.reason: Variant marker on the related-list header; no CSS rule in 2.264.3.

slds-is-sorted_desc.reason: Sort-state marker for descending columns (ascending has CSS); the arrow is flipped by the icon choice.

slds-form.reason: Record-detail form container; rows and items carry the layout (.slds-form__row / .slds-form__item).

slds-tile__title.reason: Title element of a tile; typography comes from the heading / link inside.

patterns.values: utility icon names in src/app/components/icons/registry.ts (raw symbol names)
patterns.blueprint: Icons — utility icon container (ui/components/icons/base/example.jsx: 'slds-icon_container slds-icon-utility-' + symbol)
patterns.reason: Blueprint names the utility icon on its container; SLDS has no CSS for it (only per-icon hooks in other components).
